goal: Reviewable public source annotation proposals to distinguish semantic reference visibility from initial-query occupancy.
note: D_PROPOSED means an AI reviewer judges the local wood landmark apparently observable. It is not DIRECT_VISIBLE ground truth. U/rejected candidates are retained to expose ambiguity and wrong-part confusions.
required_review: Confirm flat-pallet target instance versus box/crate/load.
Confirm point is a stable named wood-base landmark and coordinate uncertainty.
Specify whether/how it maps to an operational full-pallet semantic keypoint identity; do not force an8slot mapping.
If accepted in a future conditional-teacher protocol, preserve exact provenance. Only an actual human/official annotation can upgrade provenance to humanverified/official.
No natural before/after correspondence across the3frames is claimed; same-pixel subtraction is invalid under moving camera.

records.target: Low wooden pallet under the large foreground LEFT cardboard carton. The large wooden transport crate on the RIGHT is a different object.

points.part: Rightmost visible outer top-deck corner of the left wooden pallet
points.evidence: Visible horizontal wood deck strip ends at the right outer wood face; a vertical wood block/edge descends below it. This is below the cardboard base, not a carton corner.
points.caveat: Pallet is cropped by the left image edge. Complete pallet cuboid orientation and native8 semantic slot are not established.

points.evidence: Cardboard bottom edge and wood top strip touch/overlap. A unique full-pallet corner is not visually established.
points.caveat: Do not certify D/E/S from this seam.

points.part: Bottom corner/foot of the separate large wooden transport crate on the right
points.evidence: Connected to the large upright crate body; no separate flat-pallet identity established.
points.caveat: Wood material alone does not make this a flat-pallet reference corner.

records.coordinate_rule: Original1280x720pixel centers; crop-coordinate=original_xy-(left,top), no estimated coordinate repair.
records.semantic_scope: Local visually proposed wood-pallet-base landmark only. No asserted correspondence to current evaluation reference slots.

records.target: Low wooden pallet carrying the large foreground RIGHT cardboard box/AprilTag.

points.part: Near lower outer corner of the visible wooden pallet support block
points.evidence: Two visible wood block faces converge near the floor; the laminated bottom edge turns at this point. It lies below the box/marker and is connected to the low pallet structure.
points.caveat: This is a local wood-base landmark candidate. The pallet extends beyond the right image edge; full cuboid slot/orientation remains unmapped.

points.evidence: Paper/box lower edge overlaps the upper deck region. The apparent corner may belong to the attached marker or box rather than the pallet.
points.caveat: Do not use as a certified pallet semantic reference.

points.part: Lower cardboard-box corner above the rear wood support
points.evidence: The visible vertical edge belongs to the loaded cardboard box, above the pallet wood.
points.caveat: A load corner cannot substitute for a pallet-base corner.

records.coordinate_rule: Original1280x720pixel centers; crop-coordinate=original_xy-(left,top), no estimated coordinate repair.
records.semantic_scope: Local visually proposed wood-pallet-base landmark only. No asserted correspondence to current evaluation reference slots.

records.target: Low wooden flat pallet beneath the purple plastic crate stack on the RIGHT.

points.part: Leftmost visible outer top-deck/end-board corner of the wooden pallet
points.evidence: Light wood top boards terminate against the vertical wood end board; the low deck is distinct from the purple crate stack above.
points.caveat: Boundary is soft and partly rounded at native resolution; exact pixel is uncertain. Rear/right pallet extent is clipped, so current-style8-slot mapping is not established.

points.part: Lower left visible wood end-board boundary
points.evidence: Wood edge/floor shading and board thickness overlap; a unique lower structural corner cannot be fixed confidently.
points.caveat: Possible alternative local landmark only; no D/E/S certainty.

points.part: Lower purple plastic crate edge where it meets the wood deck
points.evidence: Purple material and crate ribs continue upward; this is the loaded crate, not the wood pallet.
points.caveat: Do not transfer crate-corner visibility to the pallet reference.
